children: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development on Thursday announced a €344 million loan to Moldova to update its strategic road links.
Financing will support the rehabilitation and construction of around 134 kilometres (83 miles) of road links.
The loan will enable an upgrade of the R7 road in the north that connects to the Romanian border and supports traffic between Ukraine and Moldova.
It also targets the M3 road, which is a main link between the capital Chisinau and a port on the Danube.
European Union grants will complement the EBRD loan.
The EBRD has invested more than €3.1 billion in Moldova through 201 projects, it said.
